title: Falcons trade DT Orhorhoro for Jags DT Smith

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Falcons trade DT Orhorhoro for Jags DT Smith
sources.description: The Falcons have traded DT Ruke Orhorhoro to the Jaguars for DT Maason Smith. Both players were selected in the second round of the 2024 draft.
